text.comment: Welcome to The Facility! How do you feel?
Erm... fine I think.
Welcome to The Facility! How do you feel?
Oh... I'm Harper. Harper Donel. Where am I?
The Facility.
I think this one has a hearing problem.
It is your honour to meet me, Argon Donel. It is also a pleasure to have more company in The Facility.
What is The Facility? Where are we?... I mean... Where is this facility?
Where isn't really the issue. It's good you're sitting down. You're in the year 2042.
What...?! Time travel?
Not exactly. It's complicated. The high-ups know the details, but to be honest, I don't really get it myself.
Tell him about the missions.
I'm getting there!
I have to do missions for you?
Yes. I told you that your past life is now left behind. You will never go back.
But you're here for a reason. The same reason as the rest of us.
This is the Mission Hall, where we execute missions on behalf of the high-ups.
Time travel missions?
I think this one is damaged. He's not understanding the words you are saying.
DO YOU UNDERSTAND THE WORDS WE ARE SAYING?
Be calm Mission Director.
It is perfectly reasonable for an organic creature to be a little confused under these circumstances.
Harper. The missions are not time travel, but they seem like time travel.
Don't stretch your cognitive limits trying to grasp this just yet.
We have all been brought here to undertake these missions for the... high-ups, as Lissa puts it.
And we don't get to leave The Facility, except on missions.
I know it's not ideal, but it beats flaming death, right?
[silence](silent pause - not to be voiced)
We need to give this one a medical.
DO YOU NEED MEDICAL ASSISTANCE?
OK, OK, I get it.
Great. Just relax and recover. Explore The Facility.
There's a room designated for you.
Let me know when you're ready for your first mission.

You're here, bothering me, when you could be doing missions. I question your priorities.

add_npc_line.comment: Hi Harper. I hope your missions are going well.
Hello Harper. I have some admin to do. I'll get back to you later.
What would MD say? Missions, missions, missions!
I suppose we're all Quettanauts now.
Kaori's becoming a real leader here. People are looking up to her.
It's kind of satisfying to think we're just playing a game - however important it is.

text.comment: This place is amazing!

add_npc_line.comment: May the light of the Creators shine on you, human Donel.
The Creators must be pleased with your work, Harper Donel.
The future of the galaxy depends on our work here.
I am deep in thought, Harper Donel.
I wish The Creators would give me guidance.

event_cue_signalled.comment: will run 2nd time parent is signalled

add_npc_line.comment: Tammancktall is a prophet among us. Listen to his words.
vWe are the Guardians of Destiny.
Continue the work of the Creators, Guardian Harper Donel.
The human youngling, Kaori, was right about this place. The Creators have us playing games for them.

event_cue_signalled.comment: will run 2nd time parent is signalled

add_npc_line.comment: Split must find escape. Keep hunting for clues, human Harper.
Cannot draw attention to escape plans. Continue with missions.
This Facility not worthy of Split. We are slaves here.
Split focuses on missions. They distract Split.
If Split was born here, perhaps this is home.

add_npc_line.comment: Split longs for home.
Split wonders if Paranid Tammancktall might know something about these Creators.
Split must do missions. Perhaps Mission Director will send Split home.
Split does not wish to speak, human. Leave Split alone

event_cue_signalled.comment: will run 2nd time parent is signalled

add_npc_line.comment: May the Creators smile on you, Guardian Harper Donel.
Split is in moment of prayer and reflection.
Split admires your work for the Creators.
Split now Quettanaut. Split embrace way of Kaori Chen.

event_cue_signalled.comment: will run 2nd time parent is signalled

add_npc_line.comment: We are the Guardians of Destiny.
I follow Paranid Tammancktall and the truth of the Creators.
Pray with us when you have time, Guardian Donel.
So we are not Guardians of Destiny? We are... data entry of Destiny?

event_cue_signalled.comment: will run 2nd time parent is signalled

add_npc_line.comment: Missions are plentiful. We will profit from success.
I must beat the scores of human Kaori. She is a winner.
I shall wager one Argnu steak on your next mission, Harper Donel.
Greetings, friend Harper. I trust you are maintaining good mission scores?

add_npc_line.comment: I am preparing for my next mission.
The Quettanauts have celebrated my levelling up.
My advice to you is: total player immersion.
Level up, Harper Donel!
Kaori is an inspiration to us all.
